about: Twenty moments from story-pictures.json, each to be drawn three ways with everything else equal (evals/paired.ts): today's routing with its floor-plan mock-up (mockup), an edit of the previous picture the same run drew (edit), and the sketches alone (free). Spread over the kinds of moment the dreams have; every one has an earlier drawn moment in its run to edit, and today's plan gives every one a camera and a mock-up. The Flooded Library (library-2) is left out: its rowing boat was never sketched, so the engine refuses any picture with the boat in it, and its water moments have no floor-plan camera.

rows.reason: Tomas as a boy beside the dreamer in the tiny lift, through their eyes: a person whose age has changed, which only today's plan brings in-between pictures for.
An empty orchard where Tomas was: a view of a place with nobody in it, judged only partly right.
The dreamer's own hand opening the red door on warm light: a point-of-view action on a thing standing alone in a field.
The paper boat in the dreamer's hands, through their eyes, the father's table behind: judged partly right because the father went missing.
The open suitcase of letters held out toward the dreamer: a held thing whose look has changed (opened), carried by an in-between picture only in today's plan.
The hand holding the brass key, judged wrong (drawn as the whole dreamer); today's floor plan renders a different mock-up from the run's.
The paper boat held up in the round room, judged wrong (the tractor inside the room, the dreamer twice); today's mock-up differs from the run's.
Two people small in a snowy nowhere walking to a red door standing alone: a wide outdoor shot with a lot of empty space.
The yellow boat between flooded shelves with a whale under it: a wide shot of three sketched things at very different sizes.
The boat risen to the high round window over the drowned city, judged partly right (the boat stayed low): height in a wide shot.
Books lifting off the shelves like birds as the water comes in: the library's change of state, with its in-between picture in today's plan.
The water risen over the desks, the dreamer standing in it: the second step of the same change, from a picture of the first.
The two sisters at the fish stall in a packed night market: a crowd said only in words, around three sketched people.
A classroom of still, faceless students, judged partly right (not the classroom of its sketch); the last picture drawn before it is of another place, the corridor.
Inside the tractor cab from behind, the grass bending outside: a vehicle seen from within, after a picture of its other side.
The grandfather with the suitcase on his knees in the old train at night, snow outside: seated people in a railway carriage.
The dream's jump into the tractor beside a stranger, judged partly right (the cab read as a van's): an edit across a jump to another place.
The dog looking back at the dreamer on the beach, judged wrong (writing in the sky, a different dog): an animal that must match its sketch.
The white horse lowering its nose to the dreamer's hand, through their eyes, judged partly right (the apples stopped glowing).
The grandfather handing the suitcase to the dreamer before the red door: two people and a handed-over thing, facing each other.
